label: PyCharm AI chat (template)
description: Build a scoped GUI map for the AI chat panel, then pass --map to vdisplay ide prompt.
build_example: vdisplay map build --monitor DP-1 --crop-bounds x,y,w,h -o maps/pycharm-chat.json
prompt_example: vdisplay ide prompt --ide pycharm --map maps/pycharm-chat.json --text "Explain this stack trace"
